roadmap.title: Quiet campaign with basic Blink
roadmap.description: Make a manual save at each mission start and before each target choice. Avoid human kills and detection, buy no powers, and use the nonlethal target removals. Check results before continuing; reload the saved campaign if a condition failed.

roadmap.title: High-chaos campaign and paintings
roadmap.description: Start a separate campaign for the high-chaos ending. Complete the early Granny Rags and Slackjaw jobs, collect every painting, and buy powers for combat achievements. Save before the Flooded District side choice and obtain both outcomes by reloading.

roadmap.title: The Knife of Dunwall: quiet route
roadmap.description: Finish the three missions without detection or human kills. Buy all five favors, talk to Delilah’s statue and save your completed campaign for import into Brigmore.

roadmap.title: The Knife of Dunwall: high chaos
roadmap.description: Use another campaign for high chaos, the rat mine kill and the Empress statue assassination. Keep manual saves if combining combat unlocks with the quiet route.

roadmap.title: The Brigmore Witches: quiet route and savings
roadmap.description: Import a wealthy low-chaos Knife save or begin with 3,000 coins. Avoid purchases, collect valuables, and finish unseen with no human kills and at least 10,000 coins. Save before mission departures and the finale.

roadmap.title: The Brigmore Witches: high chaos and favors
roadmap.description: Use a separate campaign to buy eight favors, use Pull as a shield and obtain high chaos. Retain the quiet campaign save.

roadmap.title: Dunwall City Trials
roadmap.description: Collect each doll and the Expert Burglar figurines. Complete the individual challenge objectives, then earn 30,000 points on all ten Normal and six Expert challenges.

achievements.description: Pickpocket items worth a total of 200 coins
achievements.summary: Pickpocket at least 200 coins’ worth of valuables during one campaign.

steps.text: Take coin purses from people before knocking them out; the guests at @loc{Lady Boyle’s party} offer many opportunities.

achievements.description: Kill characters with each weapon and offensive gadget
achievements.summary: Kill a human with each of the eight weapon and offensive gadget types in one campaign.

guide.context: Keep every kill on the same campaign save. Piero can still sell ammunition during The Loyalists; stock up before leaving for Kingsparrow Island.

steps.text: Collect the incendiary bolt blueprint behind the rolling door in the @loc{Distillery}, the sticky grenade blueprint in the @loc{Boyle Estate entrance security office}, and the explosive bullet blueprint in @loc{General Tobias’s office} during Return to the Tower.

Buy the unlocked ammunition from @npc{Piero}. Use the sword, pistol bullet, standard crossbow bolt, incendiary bolt, grenade, spring razor, sticky grenade and explosive bullet to kill a conscious human with each.
For the explosive bullet kill, shoot the ground beside the victim so the blast kills them.

achievements.description: Complete all missions after the prologue, alerting no one or killing no one but key targets
achievements.summary: Finish every mission after the prologue without detection or killing anyone except key targets.

guide.context: Nonlethal target removals also qualify, so this can share a run with Clean Hands. Separate mission-select results do not combine into a clean campaign.

steps.text: Keep manual saves before risky encounters. Reload immediately after a detection or an unwanted kill.
Check that every mission result has @mechanic{Ghost (Never detected)} checked and no kills other than key targets. Continue that same campaign to the ending.

achievements.description: Complete all missions after the prologue without alerting anyone
achievements.summary: Finish every mission after the prologue without being detected.

guide.context: Stealth kills are allowed. Finish one continuous campaign rather than collecting separate clean mission results.

steps.text: Save before risky encounters and reload if an enemy detects you. Check @mechanic{Ghost (Never detected)} on every mission result before continuing.

achievements.description: Finish the game without purchasing any supernatural powers or enhancements, besides Blink
achievements.summary: Finish the campaign without buying any power or enhancement, including Blink level 2.

guide.context: Bone charms and purchased equipment upgrades are allowed.

steps.text: Leave every rune upgrade unpurchased and finish the story using only the granted @mechanic{Blink level 1}. Save before opening the power menu so an accidental purchase can be undone.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy using a Wall of Light
achievements.summary: Use a Wall of Light to kill an enemy.

steps.text: Rewire a @mechanic{Wall of Light}, then carry an unconscious guard into the field. Save first and reload afterward if keeping a nonlethal run.

achievements.description: Assassinate 10 unaware enemies
achievements.summary: Assassinate ten unaware enemies within a single campaign.

steps.text: Approach guards from behind and use the sword assassination before they detect you. Accumulate ten kills on the same campaign save.

achievements.description: After escaping prison, complete a mission without alerting anyone, and kill less than 5 people
achievements.summary: Finish a mission after the prison escape with no detections and fewer than five kills.

steps.text: Complete @loc{High Overseer Campbell} unseen with zero to four kills. Use manual saves to undo detections or excess kills before finishing.

achievements.description: After escaping Coldridge Prison, complete a single mission without alerting anyone
achievements.summary: Finish a mission after Coldridge Prison without being detected.

steps.text: Complete @loc{High Overseer Campbell} with @mechanic{Ghost (Never detected)} checked on the results screen. Reload a manual save if spotted.

achievements.description: Make others kill 5 of their own allies
achievements.summary: Make enemies kill five members of their own faction.

guide.context: Save before setting up the bodies; reload after unlocking this if preserving a nonlethal campaign.

steps.text: In @loc{House of Pleasure}, knock out five Distillery thugs and place their bodies together.
Lure another thug toward the pile and stand so his fire breath hits the unconscious thugs. Let the flames kill his five allies.

achievements.description: Kill 5 characters with Drop Assassination
achievements.summary: Perform five lethal drop assassinations during one campaign.

steps.text: Jump from a roof above an enemy and press the sword attack as you fall onto the target. Perform five successful drop assassinations on the same campaign save.

achievements.description: Play from the first mission through Kaldwin's Bridge killing fewer than 10 characters
achievements.summary: Reach the end of The Royal Physician with fewer than ten kills since the campaign began.

steps.text: Keep the running human kill total at nine or fewer from the prison escape through @loc{The Royal Physician}. Reload a manual save when a kill would exceed that limit.

achievements.description: Complete the game without killing anyone
achievements.summary: Finish the entire campaign without killing any people.

guide.context: Human targets and weepers count. Rats and river krusts do not. Keep one continuous campaign; isolated mission-select clears do not repair later saves.

steps.text: Save before every risky encounter. Use sleep darts or choking, and place unconscious people away from water, falls and rats. Spare the weepers beneath the pub too.
Use the nonlethal target methods: brand Campbell, have Slackjaw remove the Pendletons, deliver Lady Boyle to Brisby, and broadcast Burrows’s recording.
Check zero human kills at each mission result. If a kill appears, reload an earlier save and continue the campaign from the corrected mission.

achievements.description: Cause 5 unintentional suicides
achievements.summary: Cause five people to kill themselves accidentally.

guide.context: Save before starting; restore that save after the unlock if maintaining a nonlethal or undetected run.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Possession level 2}. At @loc{Lady Boyle’s party}, remove the nearby music-box Overseer and clear the guards around the Wall of Light. Leave the wall unreversed.
Possess a guest and stop immediately in front of the wall. End possession while facing the field so the guest staggers into it. Do this with five guests.

achievements.description: Stay in possession of others for most of a 3 minute period
achievements.summary: Spend most of a three-minute period possessing other creatures.

steps.text: Possess a rat and enter a @loc{rat tunnel}. Wait inside for three minutes, then leave the tunnel to trigger the unlock.

achievements.description: Kill 4 enemies in less than 1 second using the crossbow
achievements.summary: Kill four enemies with the crossbow within one second.

guide.context: Save first and reload after the unlock if keeping a nonlethal run.

steps.text: Use @mechanic{Bend Time level 2} near the weepers in the building beside the Boyle Estate. Fire a lethal crossbow headshot at four separate targets before time resumes.

achievements.description: Travel 30 meters in less than 1 second
achievements.summary: Cover 30 metres in less than one second.

steps.text: Cast @mechanic{Bend Time} in an open area, then sprint and use Blink repeatedly in the same direction.

achievements.description: Kill 6 enemies in less than 1 second
achievements.summary: Kill six enemies within one second.

steps.text: During @loc{The Loyalists}, use Piero’s arc pylon with its nonlethal setting, then gather six unconscious guards into one pile.
Save, then detonate a grenade among the bodies. Reload afterward if preserving a nonlethal run.

achievements.description: Acquire 15 equipment upgrades
achievements.summary: Buy fifteen equipment upgrades within a single campaign.

steps.text: Collect coins and blueprints, then buy fifteen equipment upgrades from @npc{Piero} on the same campaign save. Finish shopping before departing for Kingsparrow Island; retain a save before that departure.

achievements.description: Collect all the Sokolov paintings
achievements.summary: Collect all eleven Sokolov paintings in a single campaign.

guide.context: Do Granny Rags’s early requests and Slackjaw’s House of Pleasure jobs to open the Flooded District sewer confrontation and its final painting. Keep a manual save before every mission departure.

collectibles.name: Campbell’s portrait
collectibles.location: Secret chamber below the Kennels stairs
collectibles.method: Press the button on the nearby statue to open the hidden room, then take the painting.
collectibles.note: Save before leaving this mission; return to that save if the painting was missed.

collectibles.name: Sokolov’s self-portrait
collectibles.method: Enter the room facing the stairs and take the painting.
collectibles.note: Save before leaving this mission; return to that save if the painting was missed.

collectibles.name: Daud portrait
collectibles.method: Look in the doorway outside the safe room and take the painting.
collectibles.note: Save before leaving this mission; return to that save if the painting was missed.

collectibles.name: Pendleton portrait
collectibles.method: Get the combination from the Art Dealer in the Golden Cat’s Silver Room and open the safe.
collectibles.note: Save before leaving this mission; return to that save if the painting was missed.

collectibles.name: Lady Boyle portrait
collectibles.method: Take the painting before carrying Sokolov back to Samuel.
collectibles.note: Save before leaving this mission; return to that save if the painting was missed.

collectibles.name: Vera Moray portrait
collectibles.method: Take the painting from the display hall without alerting the party.
collectibles.note: Save before leaving this mission; return to that save if the painting was missed.

collectibles.name: Spymaster portrait
collectibles.method: Search above the bedroom fireplace and take the painting.
collectibles.note: Save before leaving this mission; return to that save if the painting was missed.

collectibles.name: Empress portrait
collectibles.location: Room beside the Lord Regent’s bedroom
collectibles.method: Reach the second-floor walkway from the entrance hall and search above the fireplace.
collectibles.note: Save before leaving this mission; return to that save if the painting was missed.

collectibles.name: Weeper painting
collectibles.location: Upper room near the first waterfront rooftops
collectibles.method: Climb the chain near the route toward your equipment, cross the catwalk and enter the room with a weeper.
collectibles.note: Save before leaving this mission; return to that save if the painting was missed.

collectibles.name: Torturer painting
collectibles.method: After passing Daud, descend the chain and stop at the third-floor opening to collect the painting.
collectibles.note: Save before leaving this mission; return to that save if the painting was missed.

collectibles.name: Outsider painting
collectibles.location: Granny Rags’s room beneath the whale corpse
collectibles.method: Enter the room beside the Granny Rags and Slackjaw confrontation and take the painting before leaving the sewers.
collectibles.note: Save before leaving this mission; return to that save if the painting was missed.

achievements.description: Collect 10 bone charms
achievements.summary: Collect ten bone charms.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Heart} to locate nearby bone charms and collect ten during the campaign.

achievements.description: After Coldridge Prison, elude 5 pursuers at once without killing them or leaving the map
achievements.summary: Evade at least five pursuers together after the prison escape, keeping them alive and staying on the same map.

steps.text: Draw at least five guards into a chase behind the @loc{High Overseer’s offices}. Blink onto a roof and hide until they abandon the pursuit.
Do not kill a pursuer or change maps. Save before provoking the chase and reload afterward if preserving an undetected run.

achievements.description: Fight with 5 enemies at once, without any of them surviving
achievements.summary: Kill every enemy in a fight involving at least five enemies at once.

steps.text: At the prison’s final escape, let five guards engage you together and kill them before leaving combat. Save before provoking the fight and reload afterward for a nonlethal run.

achievements.description: Complete the Intro missions
achievements.summary: Finish the introductory prison escape and sewer missions.

steps.text: Escape @loc{Coldridge Prison}, cross the sewers and take Samuel’s boat to the Hound Pits Pub.

achievements.description: Eliminate High Overseer Campbell
achievements.summary: Remove High Overseer Campbell from power.

guide.context: Killing Campbell also unlocks this, but closes the nonlethal target route unless you reload.

steps.text: For the nonlethal route, read about the Heretic’s Brand in the archive and take the interrogation-room key from a nearby guard.
Spill both wine glasses at Campbell’s meeting, then put Campbell and Curnow to sleep.
Retrieve the branding iron from the interrogation room. Carry Campbell to its chair and brand him.

achievements.description: Find Emily Kaldwin
achievements.summary: Rescue Emily Kaldwin from the Golden Cat.

steps.text: Find @npc{Emily} inside the Golden Cat during House of Pleasure and bring her back to Samuel.

achievements.description: Complete the Bridge mission
achievements.summary: Finish The Royal Physician by abducting Anton Sokolov.

steps.text: Knock @npc{Sokolov} unconscious in his house and carry him to Samuel’s boat.

achievements.description: Assassinate the Lord Regent, Hiram Burrows
achievements.summary: Kill Lord Regent Hiram Burrows.

steps.text: Kill @npc{Hiram Burrows} inside Dunwall Tower. For a nonlethal campaign, make a manual save before attacking and reload after the unlock.

achievements.description: Expose the Lord Regent's crimes and bring about his arrest
achievements.summary: Have the Lord Regent arrested by broadcasting his confession.

steps.text: Disable the arc pylon on the broadcast tower stairs and speak to the @npc{Propaganda Officer} at the top.
Open the safe in Burrows’s bedroom with @item{935}. Take the audiograph to the broadcast console and play it.

achievements.description: Recover your belongings
achievements.summary: Retrieve Corvo’s confiscated equipment in The Flooded District.

steps.text: Follow the optional equipment objective to @loc{Greaves Refinery}. Fill the empty whale oil tank and power the bridge, then descend to your belongings.
Pick up your equipment before leaving the Flooded District. Keep a save before departure in case you skip the detour.

achievements.description: Complete the game
achievements.summary: Reach an ending of the main campaign.

steps.text: Finish @loc{The Light at the End} and reach the ending.

achievements.description: Finish the main campaign with high chaos.
achievements.summary: Finish the main campaign with high chaos.

guide.context: Use the second run for this ending. Keep the low-chaos campaign save separately.

steps.text: Kill many human enemies throughout the campaign and check the @mechanic{High Chaos} mission results. Finish the final mission on that campaign.

achievements.description: Finish the main campaign with low chaos.
achievements.summary: Finish the main campaign with low chaos.

guide.context: A zero-kill run also supplies the low-chaos ending. Keep this campaign separate from the high-chaos run.

steps.text: Avoid human kills throughout the campaign, then finish the final mission. Check the chaos rating at each mission result.

achievements.description: Escape Coldridge Prison and cross the sewers without being detected.
achievements.summary: Escape Coldridge Prison and cross the sewers without being detected.

steps.text: Stay unseen during the prison escape and sewer journey. Make a manual save before detonating the prison wall, then jump directly into the river after the explosion. Reload that save if spotted.

achievements.description: Complete every Granny Rags side mission.
achievements.summary: Complete every Granny Rags side mission.

guide.context: Reload the confrontation save afterward to pursue Street Conspiracy on the other branch.

steps.text: In @loc{High Overseer Campbell}, remove the men at Granny’s door. Take the rat viscera from Galvani’s laboratory and contaminate the Distillery for her.
During @loc{House of Pleasure}, complete Slackjaw’s request for Crowley’s recording to open the later sewer encounter.
Save before choosing a side in the @loc{Flooded District} confrontation. Help Granny cook Slackjaw, then take her reward.

achievements.description: Complete every Slackjaw side mission.
achievements.summary: Complete every Slackjaw side mission.

guide.context: Keep the confrontation save to obtain Gentleman Caller on the other branch.

steps.text: Do Granny Rags’s doorstep request in @loc{High Overseer Campbell} to enable the later confrontation.
In @loc{House of Pleasure}, bring Slackjaw Crowley’s recording from Galvani’s house. Get the Art Dealer’s safe code from the Golden Cat and give it to Slackjaw.
Save before the Flooded District confrontation. Find Granny’s cameo beneath the pillows on her bed. Put it in her furnace and burn it, defeat Granny, then take her key and release Slackjaw.

achievements.description: Rob the Art Dealer’s safe before giving its combination to Slackjaw.
achievements.summary: Rob the Art Dealer’s safe before giving its combination to Slackjaw.

guide.context: Save before reporting back to Slackjaw; handing over the code first loses the required order.

steps.text: Bring Crowley’s recording from Galvani’s house to Slackjaw during @loc{House of Pleasure}. Question the Art Dealer in the Golden Cat’s Silver Room using the electric chair until he gives you the code.
Use that code to empty the safe in the Art Dealer’s apartment. Only then return the combination to Slackjaw.

achievements.description: Kill Morgan Pendleton with steam.
achievements.summary: Kill Morgan Pendleton with steam.

guide.context: The steam can only be activated once; put Morgan in the room before turning the valve.

steps.text: Save before using the @loc{Golden Cat steam room}. Clear its occupants; if Morgan is elsewhere, knock him out and carry him inside. Close the door.
Fit the spare valve wheel to the pipe in the adjacent control room and turn it to fill Morgan’s room with steam. Reload afterward if preserving a nonlethal run.

achievements.description: Finish Lady Boyle’s Last Party without disrupting the party.
achievements.summary: Finish Lady Boyle’s Last Party without disrupting the party.

guide.context: Save before entering the estate; reload if your actions disrupt the party.

steps.text: Enter with an invitation and keep weapons sheathed. Give @npc{Miss White} a drink to identify your target, then speak to Lord Brisby about removing her.
Knock out the correct Lady Boyle in private and deliver her to Brisby’s boat in the cellar. Leave without alerting estate guards.

achievements.description: Reach the highest point of Kaldwin’s Bridge.
achievements.summary: Reach the highest point of Kaldwin’s Bridge.

steps.text: During @loc{The Royal Physician}, use Blink to climb the bridge structure until you reach its highest point.

achievements.description: Keep Captain Geoff Curnow alive during High Overseer Campbell.
achievements.summary: Keep Captain Geoff Curnow alive during High Overseer Campbell.

steps.text: Before leaving the pub, accept @npc{Callista’s} request. At Campbell’s meeting, spill both wine glasses so Curnow cannot drink poison.
Put Campbell and Curnow to sleep, then carry Curnow to the marked dumpster outside. Save before the meeting and reload if Curnow dies.

achievements.description: Leave Daud alive in The Flooded District.
achievements.summary: Leave Daud alive in The Flooded District.

steps.text: Steal @npc{Daud’s} key or knock him unconscious, then leave his hideout without killing him. Save before entering so you can undo an accidental death.

achievements.description: Disable at least five security devices on Kingsparrow Island.
achievements.summary: Disable at least five security devices on Kingsparrow Island.

steps.text: Remove the whale oil tanks or rewire both entrance @mechanic{Walls of Light}. Their controls are reached through the hatch in the outer wall between the entrances.
Disable the beach watchtower, the arc pylon below the beach entrance, and the arc pylon on the walkway toward the lighthouse.
Finish all five before ending the mission. Keep a save before approaching Havelock.

achievements.description: Save Emily Kaldwin alive in the final mission.
achievements.summary: Save Emily Kaldwin alive in the final mission.

steps.text: On a low-chaos run, take @npc{Havelock’s} key and unlock Emily’s room at the lighthouse. Save before confronting Havelock so you can undo a failed rescue.

achievements.description: Remove every main assassination target through the indirect nonlethal method.
achievements.summary: Neutralize every primary assassination target indirectly during one campaign.

guide.context: Keep these outcomes on one campaign. Save before each target encounter so a lethal outcome can be undone.

steps.text: Brand Campbell in the interrogation chair. In House of Pleasure, give Slackjaw the Art Dealer’s code so his gang removes the Pendleton twins.
Deliver the correct Lady Boyle to Brisby’s cellar boat. In Return to the Tower, broadcast the Lord Regent’s confession from his safe using code @item{935}.

achievements.description: Assassinate a Whaler assassin.
achievements.summary: Assassinate a Whaler assassin.

steps.text: During @loc{House of Pleasure}, sneak behind a rooftop assassin near the Distillery and use a sword assassination. Save first and reload afterward if keeping a nonlethal run.

achievements.description: Possess a fish.
achievements.summary: Possess a fish.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Possession level 1}, approach a fish in the water and cast Possession on it.

achievements.description: Enter a rat tunnel while possessing a rat.
achievements.summary: Enter a rat tunnel while possessing a rat.

steps.text: Cast @mechanic{Possession} on a rat and guide the rat into one of the small rat passages.

achievements.description: Grab a live grenade and use it to kill an attacker
achievements.summary: Kill an attacker with a live grenade you picked up.

guide.context: Save before starting and reload afterward if maintaining a nonlethal or undetected run.

steps.text: Let an Overseer throw a grenade, then use @mechanic{Bend Time} to pick it up safely and throw it back at him. Let the blast kill the attacker.

achievements.description: Kill a tallboy with only your sword
achievements.summary: Kill a tallboy using only the sword.

steps.text: Blink above a @enemy{tallboy’s} rider and perform a drop assassination. Save first and reload afterward if preserving a nonlethal run.

achievements.description: Find Emily's doll hidden in each of the 10 challenges
achievements.summary: Find Emily’s hidden doll in each of the ten Dunwall City Trials challenges.

collectibles.name: Mystery Foe
collectibles.location: White bedroom off the right-hand corridor
collectibles.method: Blink onto the rock pillar inside the bedroom and collect the doll.

collectibles.name: Burglar
collectibles.location: Secret room on the third floor
collectibles.method: Search the hidden room on the broken upper level and pick up the doll.

collectibles.name: Back Alley Brawl
collectibles.location: High chain above the starting area
collectibles.method: Climb the metal roof ahead of the start, Blink along the floating debris to the chains, then follow the chain upward and Blink right to the doll.

collectibles.name: Assassin’s Run
collectibles.method: After clearing the weepers, look on top of the shelf in their small side room.

collectibles.name: Oil Drop
collectibles.method: Search the bush to the right of the starting position.

collectibles.name: Bend Time Massacre
collectibles.method: Run along the right side of the building, cross the two floating metal platforms and climb the high beam back to the roof. Cross the next platforms on the right to the farthest one.

collectibles.name: Kill Chain
collectibles.location: Passage beneath the end of the tracks
collectibles.method: Go down the right-hand stairs and follow the tracks to their broken end. Drop onto the rocks below, turn left and enter the passage; the doll is on the right.

collectibles.name: Bonfires
collectibles.location: High floating island with a tree
collectibles.method: Reach the slanted building, then sprint and double-jump to the island. Look against the tree.

collectibles.name: Train Runner
collectibles.location: Purple opening beside the trackside doorframe
collectibles.method: Enter the opening to the right of the doorframe and look above the painting in the inner right corner.

collectibles.name: Kill Cascade
collectibles.location: Train carriage above the final drop
collectibles.method: Stop at the DUNWALL sign before the last drop. Look up to the left, Blink into the carriage and search its left side.

achievements.description: Complete all Normal and Expert challenges with a 3-Stars rating
achievements.summary: Earn three stars in every Normal and Expert Dunwall City Trials challenge.

guide.context: There are sixteen required results: ten Normal and six Expert.

steps.text: Score at least @mechanic{30,000 points} on all ten Normal challenges. A score of 20,000 unlocks each available Expert variant.
Reach 30,000 points on each Expert variant: Bonfires, Burglar, Kill Cascade, Mystery Foe, Train Runner and Back Alley Brawl.
In Burglar, collect the six eggs before valuables to raise the multiplier. In Kill Cascade, skip smaller drops for longer assassinations; in Bonfires, keep reaching beams quickly to extend the timer.

achievements.description: Get to Wave 13 in Back Alley Brawl killing all combatants personally
achievements.summary: Reach wave 13 of Back Alley Brawl after personally killing every combatant.

guide.context: Enemy infighting invalidates the attempt even if you survive the wave.

steps.text: Kill enemies quickly enough that rival factions cannot kill each other. Include each Golden Merchant on waves 3, 6, 9 and 12.
Check your cumulative kills after waves 1–12: @mechanic{3, 6, 10, 14, 18, 23, 27, 31, 37, 42, 47, 53}. Restart if your total falls short. Reach wave 13 with all 53 kills.

achievements.description: Complete Train Runner before the train arrives at the station
achievements.summary: Beat the train to the station exit in Train Runner.

steps.text: Reach the trackside gate or doorframe ahead of the train and Blink onto its roof as it passes.
Run toward the front, Blink onto the platform above the station exit and drop through the finish before the train stops.

achievements.description: Find all of the collectable figurines in Burglar on Expert
achievements.summary: Collect all sixteen figurines in Burglar on Expert.

guide.context: First score at least 20,000 points in Normal Burglar to unlock Expert. The figurines are absent from Normal.

collectibles.name: Barrel
collectibles.method: Take the figurine from the barrel.

collectibles.name: Locker
collectibles.method: Look behind the Processed Whale Oil.

collectibles.name: Kitchen shelf
collectibles.method: Search the bottom shelf’s right corner.

collectibles.name: Bunk
collectibles.method: Look on the bunk to the left of the doorway.

collectibles.name: Rear locker
collectibles.method: Open the locker and take the figurine.

collectibles.name: Nightstand
collectibles.location: Guest room right of the stairs
collectibles.method: Search the nightstand.

collectibles.name: Fireplace corner
collectibles.method: Look on the floor behind the left side of the fireplace cover.

collectibles.name: Storeroom cabinet
collectibles.method: Open the cabinet and collect the figurine.

collectibles.name: Safe crate
collectibles.method: Take the figurine from the crate.

collectibles.name: Floating figurine
collectibles.method: Reach the floating figurine between the windows.

collectibles.name: Fireplace ledge
collectibles.method: Climb the mounted animal head to reach the small ledge.

collectibles.name: Staircase bookshelf
collectibles.method: Search the shelf beside the staircase.

collectibles.name: Doorway figurine
collectibles.method: Look immediately left of the doorway.

collectibles.name: High bookshelf
collectibles.method: Climb the white chair and then the bookcase to reach its top.

collectibles.name: Bathroom sink
collectibles.method: Look beside the sink.

collectibles.name: Bedside floor
collectibles.method: Search the floor left of the bed near the cabinet.

achievements.description: Perform a drop assassination of at least 150 meters in the Kill Cascade challenge
achievements.summary: Perform a drop assassination from at least 150 metres in Kill Cascade.

steps.text: From the tallboy’s platform, Blink to the rocks beside the ruined buildings near the final red beam. Climb the upper ledge and cross to the broken wall above the final target.
Jump toward the final red beam and drop-assassinate Jessamine’s target without landing on a ledge or another target on the way down.

achievements.description: Complete Assassin's Run with 100% accuracy using only head shots
achievements.summary: Finish Assassin’s Run with 100% crossbow accuracy and only headshots.

guide.context: Speed does not affect this unlock; take a separate run from your score attempt.

steps.text: Take time to line up every shot on an enemy’s head and spare civilians. Wait for vomiting weepers to stop moving before firing.
Check the headshot score notification after each kill. Restart after a miss or a body hit, then finish the course.

achievements.description: In Bonfires, perform all the special combination jumps in 1 round
achievements.summary: Perform all six special combination jumps in one Bonfires round.

steps.text: Choose Normal Bonfires. Each jump must end in its active beam; later beam positions are random. Collect nearby beams quickly to keep time on the clock.
First beam: drop onto the island below and left of the starting platform. Run, jump and Blink from that island into the opening beam.
Second beam through the window: Return to the start, climb the floating debris on the right and ascend the ruined building. Jump through its window into the second beam.

White building beam: look for the white building beside Jessamine’s statue, to the right of the starting platform. When its interior beam activates, jump from the moving debris and Blink through the window into the beam.
Island beam from above: locate the small island to the left of the starting platform. When its beam activates, run off the rock above that island and jump into the beam.

Island beam through the window: reach the ruined building above and behind that same small island, left of the start. When the island’s beam activates again, double-jump out and Blink through the broken window at island level into the beam. Avoid grabbing the window ledge.
Opening beam from the doll island: Reach the high island from the slanted house. When the first beam’s location lights up again, run toward Jessamine’s statue and jump down into that beam.
Confirm the brief black-and-white flash and sound after each special jump. Complete all six in the same round; restart if the timer runs out.

achievements.description: Finish Mystery Foe without using any active supernatural powers
achievements.summary: Complete Mystery Foe without activating a supernatural power.

steps.text: Sneak through the mansion, collect its clues and kill the identified target. Do not cast any active power, including Dark Vision, Possession, Bend Time and Blink. Take as long as needed.

achievements.description: Finish Chain Kill or Bend Time Massacre without failing any wave, including bonuses
achievements.summary: Clear all main and bonus waves without failure in either Bend Time Massacre or Chain Kill.

guide.context: Bend Time Massacre is the safer choice if Chain Kill fails to award the unlock despite a clean result.

steps.text: Choose @loc{Bend Time Massacre} and complete its six main waves plus each intervening bonus wave. Restart the challenge after any failed objective.

Before breaking the glass, read the current bonus objective and locate the relevant targets and objects. For the Hero bonus, throw all three whale oil tanks out of the windows instead of killing people.

achievements.description: Get the information you need from the Rothwild Slaughterhouse
achievements.summary: Obtain information about Delilah from Rothwild Slaughterhouse.

steps.text: For a nonlethal route, knock out @npc{Rothwild} and take him to the interrogation room. Get the information, then have Billie send him away in a shipping container.

achievements.description: Meet with Thalia Timsh, the Barrister's Niece
achievements.summary: Learn Delilah Copperspoon’s identity from Thalia Timsh.

steps.text: For a nonlethal removal, collect the seizure document and the key for apartment 10 in apartment 7. Search apartment 10 for the odorous sack, then put the sack into the estate’s basement vent.
Replace the documents carried by Timsh with the seizure document, then activate the ventilation. Return to @npc{Thalia} near the starting tunnel and speak to her to finish the mission.

achievements.description: Purchase all of the Favors in The Knife of Dunwall
achievements.summary: Purchase all five favors in one Knife of Dunwall campaign.

guide.context: The five favors cost 625 coins in total. Buying a favor is enough; you do not need to use it.

steps.text: Before @loc{A Captain of Industry}, open the shop’s Favors tab and buy Safe Code, The Stolen Rune and Silent Sabotage.
Before @loc{Eminent Domain}, buy Rune Drop Off and Whale Oil Delivery. Keep a save before entering each mission in case you miss a purchase.

achievements.description: Complete The Knife of Dunwall in High Chaos
achievements.summary: Finish The Knife of Dunwall with high chaos.

guide.context: Use a separate campaign from the low-chaos run.

steps.text: Kill human enemies across the three missions and finish @loc{The Surge} with high chaos.

achievements.description: Complete The Knife of Dunwall in Low Chaos
achievements.summary: Finish The Knife of Dunwall with low chaos.

guide.context: This can share a campaign with Cleaner Hands and Whisper Ways.

steps.text: Avoid human kills across the three missions and finish @loc{The Surge} with low chaos.

achievements.description: Complete The Knife of Dunwall without alerting anyone
achievements.summary: Finish The Knife of Dunwall without being detected.

steps.text: Save before risky encounters in each of the three missions. Reload after detection and confirm @mechanic{Ghost (Never detected)} on every mission result.

achievements.description: Complete The Knife of Dunwall without killing anyone
achievements.summary: Finish The Knife of Dunwall without killing any people.

steps.text: Use Rothwild’s interrogation and shipment route in A Captain of Industry, then arrange Timsh’s arrest in Eminent Domain. Spare Billie in The Surge.
Keep unconscious people safe and check @mechanic{Didn’t kill anybody} at every mission result. Reload a manual save if a death appears.

achievements.description: Attach an arc mine to a rat, resulting in a kill
achievements.summary: Kill a person with an arc mine attached to a rat.

steps.text: In @loc{A Captain of Industry}, take the arc mines from the table in the building opposite the captive laborers. Attach a mine to a rat near the oil tank.
Lure the guard toward the rat and let the mine kill him. Save before attaching the mine and reload afterward if keeping a nonlethal run.

achievements.description: Perform a drop assassination from atop the Empress statue in The Knife of Dunwall
achievements.summary: Launch a drop assassination from the Empress statue during The Surge.

steps.text: During @loc{The Surge}, Blink onto the Empress statue beside Daud’s office window. Save there, wait for an Overseer below and drop-assassinate him. Reload afterward if preserving a nonlethal run.

achievements.description: Speak with the statue of Delilah Copperspoon in Timsh's estate
achievements.summary: Speak to Delilah’s statue inside Timsh’s estate.

steps.text: In @loc{Eminent Domain}, reach the estate’s top floor and enter the room with mounted animal heads beside its doorway. Speak to the @npc{Delilah statue}.
Do this before leaving the estate; keep a manual save before mission departure.

achievements.description: Deliver (or attempt) the killing blow on Corvo
achievements.summary: Deliver or attempt the finishing blow on Corvo in the opening dream.

steps.text: During @loc{Choosing Your Mark}, fight Corvo in the dream and attack him rather than letting him defeat you without resistance. Save before the fight and reload if the unlock does not appear.

achievements.description: Break Lizzy Stride out of Coldridge Prison
achievements.summary: Rescue Lizzy Stride from Coldridge Prison.

steps.text: Free @npc{Lizzy Stride} and finish A Stay of Execution for Lizzy.

achievements.description: Restore the Undine to working condition
achievements.summary: Repair the Undine in The Dead Eels.

steps.text: Recover the engine coil for the @loc{Undine}, restore its engine and finish The Dead Eels.

achievements.description: Purchase at least 8 favors in The Brigmore Witches
achievements.summary: Buy at least eight favors in a single Brigmore Witches campaign.

guide.context: These eight unconditional favors cost 1,025 coins. Buy them on a separate run from Enough Coin to Disappear.

steps.text: Before @loc{A Stay of Execution for Lizzy}, buy Overseer Daud, Misplaced Rune and Forged Requisition.
Before @loc{The Dead Eels}, buy The Sunken Crate and The Hidden Rune.
Before @loc{Delilah’s Masterwork}, buy Hole in the Fence, Thieving Butler and Turncoat. Save before each mission departure so missed purchases can be recovered.

achievements.description: Complete The Brigmore Witches in High Chaos
achievements.summary: Finish The Brigmore Witches with high chaos.

guide.context: Keep this campaign separate from the low-chaos run.

steps.text: Kill many human enemies during the DLC and reach its ending with high chaos.

achievements.description: Complete The Brigmore Witches in Low Chaos
achievements.summary: Finish The Brigmore Witches with low chaos.

guide.context: This can share a campaign with Cleanest Hands and Silence is Golden.

steps.text: Avoid human kills throughout the DLC and reach the ending with low chaos.

achievements.description: Complete The Brigmore Witches without alerting anyone
achievements.summary: Finish The Brigmore Witches without being detected.

steps.text: Keep manual saves before risky encounters and reload after detection. Confirm @mechanic{Ghost (Never detected)} at every mission result before continuing.

achievements.description: Complete The Brigmore Witches without killing anyone
achievements.summary: Finish The Brigmore Witches without killing any people.

steps.text: Use choking and sleep darts against human enemies and witches. Keep manual saves, then check @mechanic{Didn’t kill anybody} after each mission.

In Delilah’s Masterwork, take the Void painting near the ritual site. Wait until Delilah finishes painting Emily and walks to the altar, then replace Emily’s painting with the Void painting without being seen. Hide and let Delilah finish the altered ritual. Reload if a human death appears in the mission results.

achievements.description: Survive The Brigmore Witches in low chaos with 10,000 coins
achievements.summary: Survive The Brigmore Witches with at least 10,000 unspent coins.

guide.context: The counter checks money still in your purse, not lifetime earnings. High chaos can also award this achievement despite the Steam description.

steps.text: Import a Knife of Dunwall save with a large coin reserve, or start Brigmore without importing to receive 3,000 coins.
Search each mission for valuables and avoid purchases. With a fresh 3,000-coin start, the DLC’s 7,705 available coins leave only 705 coins for missed loot and spending.
Keep a manual save before each mission departure and check your purse before the finale. Finish alive with at least @item{10,000 coins}; use a low-chaos run.

achievements.description: Use an enemy lifted with Pull as a shield
achievements.summary: Use a person held with Pull to block an enemy attack.

guide.context: Save first and reload afterward if preserving a nonlethal run.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Pull level 2}, then lift an enemy in the street fight during @loc{The Dead Eels}. Hold the victim between yourself and another attacker until an attack hits the lifted person.
